gee.note: JS can't read files — the gee/0*.js pasted bboxes/dates must mirror these values by hand. window = reference_date -/+ window_*_days (config.yaml cases.rs_2024).

nisar.note: No NISAR coverage — event predates launch (Jul 2025). Validation via OPERA DSWx-HLS and MODIS NRT Flood on cloud-free days; HLS cloud fraction quantifies what optical missed.

swot.note: Jacui main stem downstream->upstream into terminal reach 64110700015 at the Jacui delta / Guaiba head by Porto Alegre. SWORD names this stem no_data/'Taquari River', so FTS name search for 'Rio Jacui'/'Guaiba' fails; ids found via SWOT_L2_HR_RiverSP_reach_vD_Attributes FeatureServer bbox query on the AOI, ordered by dist_out via FTS /v1/rivers/reach/<id>. Hydrocron timeseries per reach. window/event_dates here are the chart window (wider than the event window: pre-flood April baseline through the June recession) and the flood start / Guaiba-Jacui crest dates for the series chart (tools/wa_swot_series.py --case rs_2024).

official_warning.source: Prefeitura de Canoas / Eclima: Aviso: Canoas terá incidência de chuva forte nos próximos dias
official_warning.note: Official municipal forecast notice warning of heavy rain and possible flooding at Praia do Paquetá; publication time, not operational alert issuance. Page JSON-LD datePublished agrees with date_gmt at https://canoas.rs.gov.br/wp-json/wp/v2/noticias/99605 (17:40:20 local, UTC-3). Page was modified 2024-11-11; body has inconsistent weekday/day labels. Earlier than INMET's 2024-04-26T16:50:00Z notice; earlier INMET forecast dated 2024-04-20 remains date-only.

damage_anchor.time_note: date only; first reported rain/flood damage in RS on 2024-04-27, not a timestamp for first damage in Canoas
damage_anchor.reported: First reported rain/flood damage in RS on 2024-04-27: flooding in parts of Livramento and Pelotas; afternoon storm damaged ~750 homes in Santa Cruz do Sul
damage_anchor.qualification: The MetSul report supports state-level rain/flood damage on 2024-04-27; it does not establish the date or time of first damage in Canoas.
damage_anchor.source: MetSul meteorological report commissioned by Canoas city government
